stemMd: A triangle has sides 7 cm, 8 cm and 9 cm. What is its area?
explanationMd: The semiperimeter is twelve. Heron’s formula gives area √[12(12−7)(12−8)(12−9)] = √(12×5×4×3) = √720 = 12√5 cm². None of the side pairs is known perpendicular.

distractorRationale.e: This assumes an unsupported base-height pair.
distractorRationale.c: This is half the correct Heron-formula result.
distractorRationale.d: This uses half the product of two sides without a right angle.
